projects.title: Palm Tree Disease Detection

services.title: AI & Agentic Workflow Automation
services.description: Designing and deploying custom multi-agent systems (CrewAI, n8n) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. I automate complex business logic and decision-making processes to streamline operations and eliminate manual bottlenecks.

services.title: Technical Product Management & AI Strategy
services.description: Taking complex SaaS and AI products from initial concept to production release. Services include PRD authoring, product roadmap strategy, backlog prioritization, and optimizing Agile workflows to accelerate delivery speed.

services.title: Machine Learning & Computer Vision Development
services.description: Building, fine-tuning, and deploying high-accuracy machine learning and deep learning models (including Computer Vision and NLP). I bridge the gap between AI research and production-grade execution.

services.title: Full-Stack & Backend Systems Engineering
services.description: Architecting scalable, high-availability web platforms and RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core, FastAPI, React, Next.js, and enterprise databases (PostgreSQL, Supabase, SQL Server).

services.title: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
services.description: Transforming raw data into actionable growth strategies through custom interactive dashboards (Power BI, PostHog, Google Analytics), KPI definition, and statistical modeling to drive high-ROI decision-making.

services.title: End-to-End Quality Assurance (QA) & Testing
services.description: Ensuring zero critical production defects through automated end-to-end testing suites (Playwright, Selenium, PyTest), RESTful API validation (Postman), and thorough manual exploratory/UAT testing.

services.title: Business Process Optimization & Venture Growth
services.description: Analyzing business workflows, supply chain efficiency, and customer acquisition funnels to slash operational costs, refine unit economics, and improve overall product margins.

aboutpara: I design, build, and ship production-grade software platforms, data systems, and automated workflows. Combining full-stack development, machine learning, and rigorous QA, I bridge the gap between technical architecture and measurable business execution. I focus on writing reliable code, eliminating operational bottlenecks, and delivering products built to scale.
